update.title: /bin/sh -c "python3 -c \"import sqlite3; sqlite3.connect('inventory.db').close()\" && ls -l inventory.db && file inventory.db"
/bin/sh -c "python3 -c \"import sqlite3; sqlite3.connect('inventory.db').close()\" && ls -l inventory.db && file inventory.db"

/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
connection.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _schema_marker (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)')
connection.commit()
connection.close()
PY
ls -l inventory.db && file inventory.db && python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
print(connection.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
print(connection.execute('SELECT sqlite_version()').fetchone()[0])
connection.close()
PY"
